purpose: Official-source comparators for electronic-appliance and radio/television repair courses.
status_note: Source-inspected records awaiting independent human review; standards and curricula are not evidence of programme delivery.

country_group_gaps.developed: No developed-economy delivered programme or national qualification with sufficiently specific published appliance and television-repair content was verified on 2026-10-18.

Perform SMD Soldering and De-soldering of discrete SMD components with due care and following safety norms using proper tools/setup.

Construct and test simple, electrical control circuits and various electrical control circuits for programmable systems.
Install, maintain and repair SMPS, UPS and inverter.
Identify, operate various controls, troubleshoot and replace modules of the LCD/LED TV and its remote.
Dismantle; identify the parts, control circuits, sensors of a various domestic appliance. Estimate and troubleshoot.
Identify different blocks of home theatre, troubleshoot and repair faulty boards.
